definitions.meaning: A meeting, an assembly, association, a society

quotations.old_english: Ðú bewruge me fram gemétinge awyrgedra
Ne ic ne gederige gemétinga heora

source_text: ge-méting, e; f. A meeting, an assembly, association, a society; conventus, conventio, convent&i-short;c&u-short;lum, congr&e-short;g&a-long;tio :-- Is undyrne uncer geméting our meeting is not secret, Beo. Th. 4006; B. 2001. Gemétingc conventus vel conventio, Wrt. Voc. 72, 75. Ðú bewruge me fram gemétinge awyrgedra protexisti mea conventu m&a-short;lignantium, Ps. Spl. 63, 2: Ps. Th. 105, 16. On gemétingum in congr&e-short;g&a-long;ti&o-long;ne, 110, 1. Ne ic ne gederige gemétinga heora non congr&e-short;g&a-long;bo convent&i-short;c&u-short;la e&o-long;rum, Ps. Spl. 15, 4. To gemoetingum conciliis, Mk. Skt. Lind. 13, 9.
